subject: general
question: A set of four numbers that begins with the number 53 is arranged from the smallest to largest. If the median is 56, which of the following could possibly be the set of numbers?
solution:
Concept used:

The median is defined to be the mean of the two middle values in the case of an even data set.

Calculation:

Option 1:

Mean of the given distribution

⇒ {57 + 61} over 2

⇒ 59

Option 2:

Mean of the given distribution</p&g
